name: ImmigrationLawHelp.org
what: Find free or low-cost nonprofit immigration legal help near you. Search by zip code or by detention center.
source: Immigration Advocates Network and Pro Bono Net (immigrationlawhelp.org/about)

name: Freedom for Immigrants: National Immigration Detention Hotline
what: Free, confidential help for people in immigration detention. From inside detention, dial 9233# (Monday to Friday, 8am to 8pm Pacific). Families can email hotline@freedomforimmigrants.org.

name: Find someone held by ICE (ICE Detainee Locator)
what: The government's search for adults in ICE custody. You need their country of birth and their A-number, or their name and birth date. It can take 1 to 2 days for a name to appear.
source: National Immigrant Justice Center, 'What to do if you or a loved one is detained'

name: Immigration court hearing information
what: Check a court date with the person's A-number.

name: Know Your Rights red cards (Immigrant Legal Resource Center)
what: Wallet cards that explain your rights if immigration agents come to your door, in 15 languages.

name: United We Dream hotline
what: Report immigration enforcement activity you see and get connected to help.
source: Listed in immigrant rights resource guides (Freedom for Immigrants resources, NYC legal help guides)

name: Washington Immigrant Solidarity Network hotline
what: Report a detention or immigration activity in Washington and get connected to resources. 7 days a week, 6am to 9pm.
source: WA State Human Rights Commission; Solid Ground; King County

name: ICIRR Family Support Hotline
what: Support for families after an immigration raid or arrest. English, Spanish, Korean, and Polish.

name: National Immigrant Justice Center Detention Project
what: Legal help for people in immigration detention in the Midwest. Tuesdays 11am to 2pm. People in detention can call collect at (312) 583-9721.

name: The Bond Between (Minneapolis)
what: Free temporary foster care for pets while families affected by ICE detention get stable, plus free pet food and vet help.
source: thebondbetween.org; MPR News, Jan 22 2026; CBS Minnesota

name: Pet care planning guide (The Bond Between)
what: A free guide to making a plan for your pets in case of immigration detention. Some legal details are specific to Minnesota.
